test_conditions.note: Results were measured on PAN-OS 12.1. Adding Virtual Systems requires a separate license.

fw_throughput_appmix_mbps.label: Firewall throughput (appmix)
test_conditions: Firewall throughput is measured with App-ID and logging enabled, using appmix transactions.

threat_prevention_throughput_mbps.label: Threat Prevention throughput (appmix)
test_conditions: Threat Prevention throughput is measured with App-ID, IPS, antivirus, antispyware, WildFire, DNS Security, file blocking, and logging enabled, using appmix transactions.

ipsec_throughput_mbps.label: IPsec VPN throughput
test_conditions: IPsec VPN throughput is measured with 64 KB HTTP transactions and logging enabled.

concurrent_sessions.label: Max concurrent sessions
test_conditions: Max concurrent sessions are measured by using HTTP transactions.

new_sessions_per_sec.label: New sessions per second
test_conditions: New sessions per second is measured with application override, using 1 byte HTTP transactions.

vsys_base.label: Virtual systems (base/max)
test_conditions: Adding virtual systems over base quantity requires a separately purchased license and a minimum of PAN-OS 11.0 and 11.1 for PA-415-5G and PA-455. PA-455-5G needs 11.2 for VSYS.

vsys_max.label: Virtual systems (base/max)
test_conditions: Adding virtual systems over base quantity requires a separately purchased license and a minimum of PAN-OS 11.0 and 11.1 for PA-415-5G and PA-455. PA-455-5G needs 11.2 for VSYS.

raw.Management I/O: 10/100/1000 out-of-band management port (1), RJ45 console port (1), USB port (2), Micro USB console port (1)
raw.Trusted Platform Module (TPM): Integrated with TPM for secure boot, hardware root of trust, and securing system secrets.
raw.EMI: FCC Class B, CE Class B, VCCI Class B
raw.Environment: Operating temperature: 32°F to 104°F, 0°C to 40°C; Nonoperating temperature: -4°F to 158°F, -20°C to 70°C; Passive cooling
